tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall dismantle exsiting material, make use of the same for columns and rafters. No other material will be provided
The contractor is responsible for any damages due to natural calamities. KOMUL will not give any compensation for until the completion of maintenance period
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the e-procurement website only

The Tenderers shall obtain the work done certificate in the prescribed format from the competent Authority not below the Rank of Executive Engineer (District level Officer) and scan the original Certificate and attach the scanned file Certificate. Original Certificates shall be produced to the Managing Director KOMUL during technical evaluation if required
The defect liability period for the work is 12 (Twelve) calendar months from completion date of same work (Final bill date).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed fabrication and other related works as prime contractor for INR. 12.25 Lakh under Govt. or Govt. undertaking bodies during any one financial year.

Liquid assets or availability of credit facilities not less than 30% of the estimated value (i.e. INR 7.35 Lakh) in the mode of credit lines/ letter of credit/from nationalized banks for meeting the tender requirements
Must have achieved, in at least 01 financial year, a minimum financial turnover twice the value of the tender
